landing.title: Conferences, Retreats, and Formation Events
landing.subtitle: Explore upcoming NAACUS events with clear schedules, locations, and registration opportunities designed to strengthen faith, leadership, and family life across African Catholic communities.

expect.title: What You Can Expect
expect.body: Each listing includes date range, location, event format, and highlights so families, parish teams, and ministry leaders can plan with confidence.

registration.title: How Registration Works
registration.body: Open an event card and submit the registration form to express interest. Our team follows up with details, confirmations, and next steps.

audience.title: Who These Events Serve
audience.body: Programs support youth, young adults, families, clergy partners, and chapter volunteers through practical formation and community building.

mapHub.title: Convention Map Hub
mapHub.subtitle: Find convention venues, nearby churches, hotels, airports, parking, transit, and essential services. Use category filters to focus your planning and open turn-by-turn directions instantly.

naacus2025.scheduleDescription: The NAACUS 2025 Bi-Annual Conference, hosted by Region 6 in Columbus, OH, brought together African Catholics from across the United States for three days of worship, learning, fellowship, and cultural celebration. Below is the complete official schedule of every session, workshop, and activity from this historic gathering.
naacus2025.theme: Theme: United in Christ for Evangelization (1 Cor. 1:10-13)

submit.thankYouMessage: Your submission has been received. Our media team will review it and get back to you soon.
submit.guideline1: Record one of the 7 standard Catholic prayers listed above
submit.guideline2: Wear African attire to celebrate our cultural heritage
submit.guideline3: Pray in your native African language
submit.guideline4: Feature youth whenever possible to inspire the next generation
submit.guideline5: Include your parish and church community participation
submit.title: Submit Your Prayer
submit.description: We invite individuals, families, and parish groups from African communities to record and submit Catholic prayers in their native African languages. Your contribution helps preserve our linguistic heritage and strengthens our shared faith.

prayerLibrary.subtitle: A growing library of Catholic prayers recorded in African languages from communities across the United States. Celebrating our heritage, uniting our faith.
prayerLibrary.title: African Catholic Prayers
